metadata.description: Zip code data with estimated population, median income, home values, and real estate agent marketing value ratings (1-5 scale)

rating_criteria.5: Highest value - High income ($150k+), high home values ($700k+), affluent demographics
rating_criteria.4: High value - Above-average income ($100-150k), good home values ($400-700k), stable market
rating_criteria.3: Moderate value - Average income ($75-100k), moderate home values ($250-400k)
rating_criteria.2: Lower value - Below-average income ($50-75k), lower home values ($150-250k)
rating_criteria.1: Lowest value - Low income (<$50k), low home values (<$150k)

metadata.note: Estimated data for all 86 cities. Numbers are approximations based on typical demographics and market conditions.
